description.text: The sixth set of the EX series, released in 2004 around the Game Boy Advance remakes it is named after, with 116 cards, 112 numbered and four secret, and two theme decks, FireRed and LeafGreen. Like the games, it keeps to the first generation. Charizard ex, Blastoise ex and Venusaur ex lead it, a Charmander was its box topper, and Articuno ex, Moltres ex and Zapdos ex were the first secret Pokémon-ex. Some classic Trainer cards came back with it.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
